processes.title: Business Tax Registration Certificate
processes.trigger: Starting business activity in the City of Los Angeles; confirm exemptions and nexus with the Office of Finance.
processes.summary: Registration process asks for entity identification, activity, address and contact details. The city describes separate police, fire and tobacco permits that may apply. A tax registration record does not settle use permission.
processes.affectedParty: The entity carrying out the local activity; franchisor obligations are a separate analysis.
processes.responsibleRole: Local operating lead, with finance and premises advisers as needed.

processes.title: Restaurant ownership/change and food plan review
processes.trigger: Buying a restaurant, new food space, or changing the covered menu/equipment/operation
processes.authority: Los Angeles County Public Health / actual City of Los Angeles planning and building authority
processes.summary: The county health permit is nontransferable. Purchase instructions distinguish the district-office route from new/major-modification plan review; the actual change/menu/equipment and city premises approvals remain separate.

processes.title: Laundry industrial-wastewater classification and surveys
processes.trigger: Proposed laundry discharge to the city sewer or receipt of an IWS survey
processes.authority: City of Houston Public Works Industrial Wastewater Service
processes.summary: The FAQ distinguishes self-service/commercial (not industrial) laundry while retaining an IWS determination for industrial-waste discharge. Proposed non-domestic discharge follows IWS contact/survey review; a received survey has a separate mandatory response. Neither survey is an issued permit.
